verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch does not offer a traditional SDK (e.g., a client library for embedding/programmatic control), but it does provide official, verified integration surfaces — a CLI (npm package, confirmed working via probe) and an MCP server (confirmed handshake) — that an AI-native user could build against. This covers the spirit of programmatic/agentic building but not a dedicated SDK. missing for 10: an explicit official SDK/client library (e.g., JS/Python package) for building custom integrations, independent developer corroboration of building on these interfaces.
